MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

2. Solve for x: x + 6 = 10. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

5. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

7. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

8. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 2

9. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 12 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

10. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

11. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 17
   D. 73

12. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 7 cm and 24 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 27
   C. 17
   D. 25

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 42
   C. 24
   D. 12

14. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 41
   C. 13
   D. 3

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 14

16. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 4
   C. 12
   D. 33

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
